title: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post[body]' parameter in…
description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.2.2 is vulnerable to stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the 'post[body]' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages.
